source: MOSPI Index of Industrial Production via https://data.gov.in/ (Open Government Data)
note: SEED pack. `value` is the latest headline IIP YoY growth; refresh it from the free data.gov.in IIP series with scripts/refresh_macro.py --kind iip before relying on the magnitude. `neutral` is the trend industrial-growth baseline that maps to a zero nudge. `sector_sensitivity` is a maintained crosswalk of how cyclical each sector is to industrial activity (0..1; both NSE-Industry and yfinance taxonomies) and is NEVER touched by a fetch. tailwind = clamp(((value-neutral)/IIP_SCALE) * sensitivity, -1, 1). Direction-of-support signal, not investment advice.
